message:
# Description

This PR adds a new dotnet-csproj-cataloger that parses .csproj files during directory scans to extract PackageReference dependencies from .NET source code. This complements the existing dotnet-deps-binary-cataloger that only works with compiled applications.

 Key Features

  - MSBuild Property Resolution: Resolves $(PropertyName) variables from PropertyGroup elements
  - Smart Filtering: Skips build-time dependencies (test frameworks, analyzers, packages with PrivateAssets="all")
  - Wildcard Support: Preserves version patterns like 3.2.* and 6.2.*
  - Error Handling: Gracefully handles malformed XML and unresolved properties

  Implementation Details

  - Uses Go's encoding/xml package for robust XML parsing
  - Follows established Syft cataloger patterns with generic cataloger framework
  - Generates proper NuGet PURLs compatible with vulnerability scanning
  - Integrates seamlessly with existing directory scanning workflow

  Files Changed

  - parse_csproj.go: Core XML parser with property resolution
  - cataloger.go: Added NewDotnetCsprojCataloger() registration
  - package_tasks.go: Integrated cataloger with declared, directory, language tags
  - Comprehensive test suite with 13+ scenarios, including MSBuild property resolution

  Testing

  - Unit tests for XML parsing, property resolution, and filtering logic
  - Integration tests with real .csproj files from test fixtures
  - Edge case coverage for malformed XML, conditional references, and build-time packages
  - Successfully tested against the weatherforecast-steeltoe example from the issue, and a selection of "random" repos from a [search](https://github.com/search?q=path%3A**%2F*.csproj&type=code) of GitHub
